issues.description: Bug in memoization lookup — the code checks "if mask in memo: return memo[memo]". This uses the dictionary object `memo` as a key, causing a KeyError/TypeError or returning wrong value. This will crash or produce incorrect behavior whenever memoization is hit.

Algorithmic approach is exponential (bitmask DP over n = number of differing positions). n can be up to 500 per problem constraints; a 2^n bitmask DP is infeasible (time/memory explosion). This makes the solution non-scalable and unsuitable for the required input sizes.
No tests or test harness were provided in the workspace to validate correctness (unit tests covering sample cases and edge cases are missing).

The implemented cost calculation uses min(x, abs(diffs[j] - diffs[i])). While that captures selecting between the arbitrary-pair cost x and a distance-based chain of adjacent ops, the overall logic for combining multiple operations (and interactions between non-local adjacent flips) is nontrivial — due to the exponential pairing approach this implementation is unlikely to capture optimal structured DP for larger inputs. Review and replacement with the known O(n) / O(n^2) DP/greedy approach is recommended.
